text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Come along, everyone!
Today is the 4th Tracen Island Evaluation Meeting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you finished with the cleaning?
Make sure to greet everyone properly and cheerfully!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're lookin' mighty fired up!
What's got into ya?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Whenever I remember Mr. Tucker's stories, I get so fired up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When I joined this project,
I did a little research on training facilities
around the world, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "There isn't a facility anywhere else designed to stimulate instinct! At least, not from what I've researched!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that so?
I did think it was pretty unusual, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's why I'm so excited!
I'm just so happy I get to be here for its completion...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Truly, 'a constellation of hearts connected by a warm meal'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't really get all that, though.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you guys!
It's about to start! Gather 'round~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let's get going then!
Off to battle we go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Fired up and ready, bring it on! That's right~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the 4th Tracen Island Evaluation Meeting began!
